10341.overview: Illusions is a surreal ColecoVision video game in which the player maneuvers blobs around the screen, trying to get them to merge, or, alternatively, split apart. At times, lizards may chase the blobs around. The water bucket, when spilled, can cause the lizard to turn into a fish. If the fish remains there too long, however, it turns into a bird. The game was created by Nice Ideas, a division of Mattel that was located midway between Cannes and Nice.

10342.overview: In this brilliant text and graphics game, you start with a guitar, a few bucks and enough raw talent to sit in with the Stones or the Police. Now you've got some big decisions to make as you pick one of three levels and let IT'S ONLY ROCK 'N ROLL take you down a whirlwind road seeking the unbelievable wealth, status and popularity points you'll need to succeed. If you're really good if you can avoid exhausting tours, bad managers. lousy material and too much fun — if you can keep your money, stay happy, and interpret the record charts and newspaper headlines — you'll be the all time reigning KING OF ROCK AND ROLL! Fail and you'll be playing the opening act blues. But whether you end up a superstar or a has-been, ITS ONLY ROCK 'N ROLL AND YOU'LL LIKE IT! LOVE IT! YES YOU WILL!

443123.overview: Ice Muncher is a homebrew arcade-style video game released for the ColecoVision console in 2023. Programmed by developer Nicolas Campion (Nicam), the game was created to fill a gap for fans after an official port of Sega's classic arcade game Pengo failed to materialize on the system. Synopsis & Gameplay The game serves as an uncompromised, unofficial clone of the 1982 arcade hit Pengo. The Protagonist: You control a penguin trapped in an icy maze environment. The Mission: Players must survive waves of adversarial creatures (Sno-Bees) patrolling the maze. The Mechanics: You defeat enemies by kicking large blocks of ice across the screen, crushing any enemies caught in their path. Ice blocks can also be destroyed to alter the layout of the maze or find hidden bonuses. Victory Condition: A level is cleared once all enemies are eliminated or three special diamond-marked ice blocks are lined up for a massive point bonus.23.

456812.overview:
Impetus is an action-packed, vertically scrolling, retro shooter originally created by Japanese developer Inufuto. Designed for the ColecoVision system, it features classic arcade-style shoot-'em-up mechanics, fast-paced enemy encounters, and a mission to clear the stage by destroying the enemy base.

- The Mission: Players pilot a fighter craft through continuous, vertically scrolling levels. The primary objective is to reach and destroy the main enemy base at the end of each run, while avoiding enemy fire and obstacles.

- Lives/Continues: The game is structured to give you three chances; if your player base is destroyed three times, it triggers a game over.

- Homebrew Origins: The game was released as a homebrew (fan-made, modern independent development) title. It is part of a wider portfolio of classic-style 8-bit games developed by inufuto.

475232.overview:
You are Cookie the polar bear. You are wandering in the Ice World searching for treasures hidden in the ice.
Combine L-Stones to make treasures appear but beware, Choko and Vany are chasing you!
The mazes are mostly made up of indestructible blocks, but some can be pushed around the screen or melted by hitting them with your hammer.
If you hit an enemy with your weapon, it becomes stunned for a short time. While it prevents them from chasing you, it also means you can’t move past them, so you have to think about the best place and time to hit them.

475256.overview:
Impetus is a fast-paced, vertical-scrolling shoot 'em up homebrew game developed by Inufuto for the ColecoVision. Originally released in 2022, it was later updated and expanded as Impetus Plus.  Heavily inspired by classic arcade titles like Xevious, the game challenges players to pilot a fighter craft over diverse landscapes while destroying enemy bases and aerial targets.  

Core Gameplay & Mechanics
- Dual-Weapon System: You are armed with two attacks—a forward-firing projectile for airborne enemies and an air-to-ground bomb with a targeting reticle for ground targets.
-Action-Oriented: Gameplay focuses on dodging heavy enemy fire while carefully aiming at fixed ground installations and moving aerial squadrons.
 - Arcade Aesthetics: The game pushes the ColecoVision's hardware capabilities, offering smooth scrolling and vibrant colors reminiscent of the early 1980s arcade era.

480184.overview:
You have entered the dungeons and your goals are all to the right. Walk right til you encounter enemies or obstacles.
Avoid fire as it will burn you. Do not step or fall in fire as it really hurts your health.  Some doors require a key to pass. You can only carry one key at a time and cannot progress til you pass the door.  Sometimes the key will not appear til you have defeated all the enemies in the screen.
Gerry Brophy / Eris Creations 2025 homebrew action-adventure. Released in standard, Gold, and Limited editions.
